evidence: The Inland Track links Marahau to Wainui Bay via Pigeon Saddle on the Tākaka - Tōtaranui Road.
From Marahau follow the Coast Track to Tinline Bay.
At this saddle, the track forks and an easy 45-minute descent begins to the Wainui car park.

doubts: Start ref F3 (where Coast Track meets Harvey Road, about 1 km from the Marahau place point) is taken as the Marahau start, since the text says to follow the Coast Track from Marahau. No road-end feature is clearly the Wainui car park (F6, Wainui Track at Bird Road, lies well inland of Wainui Bay; F1 is the Taupo Point Track), so the end has no ref. Holyoake Clearing and Moa Park have shelters, but the text does not say they have bunks, so only Castle Rock Hut and Awapoto Hut are listed as huts. The Canaan access point is given its road end (F7, Moa Park Track at Canaan Road) but the text does not say which track it leads onto. The page mentions linking with the Abel Tasman Coast Track or a water taxi for a round trip but does not describe one, so no loop way is recorded. Which of the two Porter Rock/lookout side tracks is which is not stated.
